description:
## Context

The audio-tools scenario (see `research/audio-provider-routing-contract`) needs an LPBS tier in its per-capability provider chains (BYOK → Vrooli/LPBS → Local). LPBS currently only supports text chat via `/api/v1/ai/chat` and `/api/v1/ai/stream`. Audio STT and TTS need their own endpoints with audio-duration pricing.

## Scope

Extend the LPBS AI gateway (`scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/`) with two new endpoints and one new pricing unit.

### New endpoints

- **`POST /api/v1/ai/transcribe`** — accepts multipart audio upload, proxies to a cloud STT provider, returns `{text, language, duration_sec}`. Charges credits by audio duration in seconds.
- **`POST /api/v1/ai/synthesize`** — accepts JSON `{text, voice, speed, response_format}`, proxies to a cloud TTS provider, returns raw audio bytes with appropriate `Content-Type`. Charges credits by output audio duration in seconds.

Summarization reuses the existing `/api/v1/ai/chat` endpoint with `Operation: audio.summarize` metadata — no new endpoint required.

### Pricing model

- Add new pricing unit `audio_duration_sec` alongside existing `tokens`.
- Internal credit unit (1/1,000,000 of a cent) is flexible enough — no schema change to the credits ledger itself.
- Reuse the existing ReserveCredits → Execute → FinalizeReservation flow with 10-minute auto-expiry.
- Reuse idempotent usage reporting via `OperationID` (UUID).

### Operation types in usage metadata

- STT: `{Operation: "audio.stt_transcribe", AudioDurationSec: N, Model: "<provider-model>"}`
- TTS: `{Operation: "audio.tts_synthesize", OutputDurationSec: N, Voice: "<voice-id>", Model: "<provider-model>"}`
- Summarize: `{Operation: "audio.summarize", PromptTokens: N, Model: "<provider-model>"}` (no LPBS change needed here)

## Acceptance criteria

- `curl -F audio=@sample.wav <lpbs>/api/v1/ai/transcribe` returns the transcribed text and writes a usage row with non-zero `audio_duration_sec` and `Operation: audio.stt_transcribe`.
- `curl -d '{"text":"hello world","voice":"..."}' <lpbs>/api/v1/ai/synthesize` returns audio bytes and writes a usage row with non-zero `audio_duration_sec` and `Operation: audio.tts_synthesize`.
- `SELECT * FROM lpbs_usage WHERE operation LIKE 'audio.%'` returns rows matching the above operations after test runs.
- Insufficient credits short-circuit before the upstream provider is called (returns 402-class error, no upstream spend).
- Idempotent `OperationID` prevents double-charging under retry.

## Out of scope

- Streaming STT/TTS through LPBS (Round 2 D2 keeps streaming local-only).
- Audio format conversion (the audio-tools caller standardizes formats).
- Choice of specific upstream provider — start with one reasonable default (e.g., OpenAI Whisper for STT, OpenAI TTS for TTS); expansion is a follow-up.

## References

- Research: `research/audio-provider-routing-contract` (Finding 4, Finding 6)
- Existing LPBS AI gateway: `scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/` (text chat endpoints for pattern to follow)
